race.description: Mittys Plate - Emerging Stars Series Ht 10 Mdn
race.comment: CARNEVALE (6) has the strongest recent form after going under by a nose at Seymour over 1411m as an odds-on favourite, following another close second at Swan Hill on soft ground. He has placed at all three runs this campaign, finds a winnable race and really should be breaking through. FLIGHT DU JOUR (9) brings a solid debut profile for the Kennewell yard, having trialled a close second at Cranbourne. Can run well first time out. ALPINE POINT (5) placed here first-up over 1118m and gets Jamie Mott for a leading stable, look for improvement. LAVANCHER (7) has been showing improvement with racing and looks a solid each way chance with a bit of early luck.
